items.title: Why did a Bajrang Dal leader hand out trishuls in a Gujarat newsroom?
items.summary: In a video from a Gujarat newsroom, a Bajrang Dal leader hands trishuls to women journalists. They then perform a beheading gesture on camera. Online, some users read it as a message to Muslims , others as an echo of the 2002 riots. The channel says both readings are wrong and that the gesture was meant for followers of Rampal, the self-styled godman who is currently out on bail. View this post on Instagram The video is from Pradesh 24 Gujarati , a channel launched last year. The women are channel head Bhumi Patel and anchor Priya Gadhvi. The men presenting the tridents were led by Jwalit Mehta, Gujarat vice president of the Bajrang Dal. The channel recently ran several stories on Rampal, and Gadhvi anchored one of them. Rahul Singh, the channel’s CEO and editor-in-chief, told us that Gadhvi, who is 21, has been receiving threats for several weeks from Rampal's followers. He said the harassment escalated when she was threatened with AI-generated nude images meant to defame her, and she was warned not to cover Rampal. According to Singh, it began on August 30.
